name: cal-aadhar-sh
comment:test: bun:test against wrangler's createTestHarness (test/harness.ts). No devDependencies on purpose: the harness is the root's wrangler pin and the types are the runtime declarations tools/gen-runtime-types.ts writes from that same pin, plus the root's @types/bun, so this project cannot carry a second miniflare or workerd. Run from THIS directory, because bun reads bunfig.toml from the cwd and cal's carries the preload the Worker source needs to load on a host.
